# libopenmpt 0.8.10

Unmodified WebAssembly/JavaScript build from the OpenMPT project:
https://lib.openmpt.org/files/libopenmpt/dev/libopenmpt-0.8.10%2Brelease.dev.js.tar.gz

Selected `bin/wasm/libopenmpt.js` and `bin/wasm/libopenmpt.wasm`.
The BSD license and bundled component notices are retained here.

SHA256:
- libopenmpt.js: 49705bd0b108823a33c6c0926bcd7cd02e5e378dd7ce7543fb7aaa797559b4d8
- libopenmpt.wasm: 7d3c33cb6c7ee3fd5ef10cc62dcc676541d33455e355cf2dde4bd0d8a5f40139

Game XM files are not included in source control. The runtime decodes the user's
imported originals locally in a worker; no CDN or audio upload is used.
